lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 2,160m) was left unchanged when H1 OP was raised 20% to 1,054m on 9/14, so the plan now implies H2 OP of ~1,106m vs 1,168m last year (-5% YoY) after H1 +28.5%; on this company's own H1 share of full-year OP (43.6% FY3/25, 41.2% FY3/26) the year runs to ~2,400-2,560m, and the company twice wrote it will give the full-year number 'when the spillover is clear' — an FY upgrade (with a payout-linked year-end dividend raise, policy 81-90% payout) is a live possibility at this release, though last year it held the plan at H1 and revised only on 2026-03-18.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-21 Q1 beat with a 'progress ahead of plan' notice: +20% day (Yahoo tape 751->901). 2026-09-14 H1 upgrade +20% with FY held: close +1.9% (1,161->1,183). 2026-04-22 FY guide of OP +8.7%: baseline -7.29%. 2025-10-22 H1 with FY held and dividend raised: baseline +2.45%. Upgrades are bought; holds are small.

findings.finding: Implied Q2 (Jul-Sep) growth decelerated sharply: from the 9/14 revised H1 less Q1 actuals, Q2 sales ~1,437m (+6% YoY vs 1,356m) and OP ~503m (+10% vs 456m), against Q1's +17.3% sales and +51% OP, which weakens the 'effect spills through the year' case for an FY upgrade today.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a visible quarterly deceleration at this name in the record; the baseline's only negative reaction (-7.29%, 2026-04-22) came on a conservative new-year guide, not a quarter.

findings.finding: The 2026-08-21 中期経営計画 states the company 'will carry out a capital increase' to fund M&A and to improve liquidity toward a Prime move; an offering announced alongside or right after the H1 results would land in the window as a negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior offering since listing; the company bought back stock via ToSTNeT-3 in July 2025. No reaction history on this line.

outside_window.finding: If the FY plan is held today, the same arithmetic (H2 implied -5% YoY) points to a later FY upgrade, as happened on 2026-03-18 last year (+21.9% OP).

lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on a series the market already has): the Q2-deceleration finding is computable from the 9/14 notice and the Q1 短信, so it was shrunk from -0.4 to -0.2; p_up already near 50.
Rule 2 (check the sign): two of three findings are negative; the strongest positive (FY upgrade + year-end dividend) was searched for and is the largest finding; no further change.
Open question 3 (a prior 業績予想の修正 kills the event): consistent with keeping abs_move_pct at 4.0 rather than the 7.29 proxy; it is not a rule, so nothing further moved.
